events.title: Bowhunter Education Field Day
events.location: Clark County Shooting Complex Education Center (Room E) 11357 N. Decatur Room E Las Vegas, NV 89131
events.description: Nevada does not require a specific Bowhunting Certificate to hunt archery; however, this class will satisfy states that require a Bowhunting Certificate. You must pass both the online class at Bowhunter-Ed.com and the final Bowhunter Education Class field day in order to complete the Nevada Bowhunter education requirements. STUDENTS MUST BRING THE ONLINE COMPLETION CONFIRMATION WITH THEM TO CLASS! What to Expect at the Final Bowhunter Education Class. The class is 4–6 hours, depending on the number of students attending and will include: a classroom session, outdoor shooting/qualifying with your PERSONAL bow. Blood trailing, demonstrations of tree stand safety, using a rangefinder and survival skills are also covered. Most of the classroom topics will pertain to Nevada-specific regulations. Be sure to have proper clothing for the outdoor sessions and drinks. After attending and passing the Final Bowhunter Education Class field day you will receive your Nevada Bowhunter Education Certificate by email when all student scores are submitted. STUDENTS ARE REQUIRED TO BRING PERSONAL BOWS AND TARGET ARROWS!

All materials will be provided for this class; NO personal firearms or ammunition will be permitted. All participants must be registered for this class. events.location: Clark County Shooting Complex (Shotgun Center) 11357 N. Decatur Blvd. Shotgun Center Las Vegas, NV 89131
events.description: This is an entry level class introducing a shooter to Sporting Clays. Enjoy an invigorating ride through the Clark County’s Sporting Clay’s course. A certified instructor will pick up 3 participants to create a team of 4 in a customized golf cart to compete with others in the class. Participants will choose 5 different stations where they will have five opportunities to hit a variety of aerial targets. Instructors will demonstrate shooting techniques and operating procedures throughout the course. This class has no age limit, no fee, but participants must be able to handle and maneuver a 12- or 20-gauge shotgun. All material and equipment will be provided; no personal firearms will be permitted. All participants must be registered to attend. You will be outside, dress accordingly! Everyone will meet at the public shotgun range to view a 3-minute safety video before heading up to the course. Top shot will receive a certificate!

events.title: Introduction to Rifle Shooting
events.location: Clark County Shooting Complex Education Center (Room E) 11357 N. Decatur Room E Las Vegas, NV 89131
events.description: STUDENTS MUST BE PRE-REGISTERED FOR CLASS!  NO REGISTRATION ON DAY OF CLASS! INTRODUCTION TO RIFLE SHOOTING!  An introductory course that teaches the fundamentals of firearms safety, range etiquette, marksmanship, and firearm handling. Students will be introduced to these topics and then put the skills into practice using .22 LR rifles in a live-fire environment. All materials will be provided for this class; NO personal firearms or ammunition will be permitted. All participants must be registered for this class. This course is free of charge, and there is an age limit of 9 years old contingent on instructor (RSO) discretion. A current Hunter education certificate is suggested prior to class. Please dress accordingly as you will be outdoors.

events.title: Introduction to Archery
events.location: Clark County Shooting Complex Education Center (Archery Range) 11357 N. Decatur Blvd. Archery Range Las Vegas, NV 89131
events.description: STUDENTS MUST BE PRE-REGISTERED FOR CLASS!  Want to learn how to shoot a Bow? Join our NDOW volunteer instructors for this hands-on class. This course is equally beneficial for those new to the sport and those with previous experience. There are no age restrictions, however students must be able to handle and draw a genesis compound bow. This class is a 3-hour course that covers range rules, safety and how to handle/operate a bow. Then test your ability on the range with certified instructors.  Range time dependent on number of students. Everyone must be registered to attend and participate. No personal equipment is permitted. We will be outside so dress accordingly and bring your own refreshments. The class is at the education center archery range at the end of the road once you enter the complex.

events.title: Introduction to Sporting Clays
events.location: Clark County Shooting Complex (Shotgun Center) 11357 N. Decatur Blvd. Shotgun Center Las Vegas, NV 89131
events.description: STUDENTS MUST BE PRE-REGISTERED FOR CLASS!  This is an entry level class introducing a shooter to Sporting Clays. Enjoy an invigorating ride through the Clark County’s Sporting Clay’s course on a 4-seater golf cart! A certified instructor will pick up 3 participants to create a team of 4 in a customized golf cart to compete with others in the class. Participants will choose 5 different stations where they will have five opportunities to hit a variety of aerial targets. Instructors will demonstrate shooting techniques and operating procedures throughout the course. Participants must be able to handle and maneuver a 12- or 20-gauge shotgun contingent on instructor (RSO) discretion.  There is no fee for this class. All material and equipment will be provided; no personal firearms will be permitted. All participants must be registered to attend. You will be outside, dress accordingly! Everyone will meet at the public shotgun range to view a 3-minute safety video before heading up to the course. Top shot will receive a certificate!
